method: Consecutive original crop frames and clip-wide contact sheets inspected locally. Brackets are inclusive zero-based decoded frames. Foot contact is visible image contact, not a force threshold. Release brackets surround visible arm/ball separation; not MER. Camera-axis entries are coarse image-supported direction hypotheses with explicit sensitivity, not calibrated laboratory axes. Source RGB stays local.
selection: Twelve pre-existing source/player-diverse reconstruction-study clips, six previously inspected Choi pitches, plus a corrected wrong-subject/incomplete-delivery case. Includes both hands, 23.98/29.97/59.94/60 fps, side and center-field views, missing preparation and occlusion. Used as diagnostics, not a statistical validation sample.
